description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining regulatory compliance and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives.

As an ADON, you will contribute to the development and implementation of nursing policies and procedures, manage staff scheduling, and provide mentorship to nursing personnel. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nursing leader to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting. We offer a competitive salary range for this position.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license (RN preferred as per internal notes)
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Previous leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves ensuring the accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, contributing significantly to resident care planning and regulatory compliance.As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial part in the interdisciplinary team, utilizing your clinical expertise to capture comprehensive resident data. This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year, reflecting your valuable contributions to our residents' well-being and the facility's operational excellence. We are looking for a long-term commitment and are not considering interim candidates for this role.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to MDS
